info.name: La Trobe University OPAL (Figshare) Public articles collections API

params.name: page
params.description: Page number. Used for pagination with page_size

params.name: page_size
params.description: The number of results included on a page. Used for pagination with page

params.name: limit
params.description: Number of results included on a page. Used for pagination with query

params.name: offset
params.description: Where to start the listing (the offset of the first result). Used for pagination with limit

params.name: order
params.description: The field by which to order. Default varies by endpoint/resource.

params.name: institution
params.description: only return collections from this institution

params.name: published_since
params.description: Filter by collection publishing date. Will only return collections published after the date. date(ISO 8601) YYYY-MM-DD

params.name: modified_since
params.description: Filter by collection modified date. Will only return collections modified after the date. date(ISO 8601) YYYY-MM-DD

params.name: group
params.description: only return collections from this group

params.name: resource_doi
params.description: only return collections with this resource_doi

params.name: doi
params.description: only return collections with this doi

params.name: handle
params.description: only return collections with this handle
